title: Bad krozInGen and freiburg reGistry of vEntricular tachycaRdia ablation (BIGGER-registry) – A single center prospective registry
summary: Ventricular tachycardias (VT) are cardiac arrhythmias of the two main chambers of the heart that should be treated immediately. In patients with scar tissue in the heart muscle (e.g. after a heart attack), VTs often complicate the course of the disease. Established therapies for these arrhythmias include antiarrhythmic drugs and catheter ablation of persistent recurrent VTs, which has been shown to reduce the number of defibrillator shocks and the recurrence of VTs and effectively increase defibrillator shock-free survival. The success of catheter ablation depends on a variety of factors, including the ablation protocol, the underlying heart disease, the location and the type of arrhythmia.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male and female patients aged ≥18 years undergoing VT ablation
2. Written informed consent for registry participation prior to enrollment
3. Ability to understand the nature of the registry and the registry related procedures and to 
comply with them
Exclusion criteria:
1. Inability to comply with the registry procedures
2. Patient is unable or unwilling to provide informed consent
